verdict.rationale: HubSpot Marketing Hub has a documented REST API, so a downloadable OpenAPI spec is a fair question. However, the probe found no spec at any of the common OpenAPI or Swagger paths, and nothing in the docs mentions a downloadable spec. Markdown docs pages and the official MCP server are adjacent features or other stories, not a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
